metadata.name: Glasswork Office
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A two-wing office block on a snowy winter night. Tide hold the building: the lobby and reception, the main hallway with the vending machines, the long hall, the cubicle farm, the break room, the server room, the projector room and the glass-walled conference room. Embers come in from the snowy parking lot and the garage at the back, by the back doors, the side doors, or up the fire escape to the upstairs offices. Every pane of glass can be shot out. In Hostage Rescue, Embers bring the four hostages out to the lot or the garage.
